module: Node "Spawn Vehicle": creates a vehicle (`core_vehicles.spawnNewVehicle` or `replaceVehicle` if `replacePlayer`), waits until it is ready then exposes its id. Input pins: `flow`, `reset` (pulse, deletes and resets), `model` (default 'pickup'), `config` (string or table, default 'vehicles/pickup/d15_4wd_A.pc'), `pos` (vec3), `rot` (quat), and hidden `licenseText`, `color` (color or paint name), `randomColor`, `name`, `replacePlayer`, `keepCamera`, `keepVehicle`, `keepOnReset`. Outputs: `flow` (once loaded), `loaded` (pulse), `vehId`. State machine `state`: 1 spawn, 2 wait for `ready`, 3 output, 4 hold, 5 failure.
notes: Spawn failure: retries every second for 10 s, then E log, goes to state 5 and, if the flowgraph is linked to an activity, aborts the mission with a fade.
The provided rotation is multiplied by `quat(0,0,1,0)` (180°).
Random color disabled for Police or Service type configs.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the state and the outputs at start.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the state and the vehicle reference.

drawMiddle.desc: Central display of the node, empty.

getCmd.desc: Builds a Lua command to call `buttonPushed(action)` on this node from another VM (inferred from code).

onSpawnFailed.desc: Called when the spawn fails: schedules a new attempt (1 s) or gives up after 10 s.

resetSpawnRetry.desc: Resets the timer and the accumulated spawn failure time to zero.

work.desc: Spawn state machine (see module); also handles `reset`.
